text:
maya patel: Hey team — heading to Lagos next month and the embassy says I need a yellow fever vaccine + TB clearance letter. Are these reimbursable under T&E? Do I need preapproval?
people-ops: Hi @maya patel — yes, entry-mandated immunizations and official medical entry docs are reimbursable. Please get preapproval if the total is expected to be > $200.
maya patel: Thanks — is a pharmacy receipt enough or do you need the clinic note?
people-ops: Receipt + proof of service required. For vaccines, the vaccine receipt (clinic invoice) is fine. For TB clearance we need the lab/clinic note that shows the test and result or the official letter used for visa processing. Upload both to the expense and tag category as `Travel - Medical (Entry Requirement)`.
jordan li: Quick note: if you use the company-approved travel clinic (link in handbook) we can fast-track approval and cover couriering of the letter if needed.
maya patel: Do I file the expense in Concur/Expense or submit to travel@redwood.com?
people-ops: Submit via Expense and attach docs. If you want us to preapprove first, email travel@redwood.com with estimated cost and service date and add "Preapproval: Immunization" in subject.
samir g: Also check your personal insurance — sometimes they cover part; but Redwood covers entry-mandated stuff regardless. Keep any refund docs if insurer reimburses.
travel-bot: Reminder: For any medical travel expenses, redwood policy requires receipts, proof of necessity, and expense category alignment. See: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/travel-medical-guidance
maya patel: Cool — one last Q: tips for submitting multi-line receipts from the clinic (they include vaccine name + admin fee + passport stamping copy fee)?
people-ops: Split the line items in Expense: vaccine charge as one line, admin/clinic fee as another, and passport/stamping fee under `Travel - Misc`. If a single combined invoice, upload the one invoice and add itemized notes in the expense description. Example description: `Yellow fever vaccine (X USD), TB test (Y USD), admin fee (Z USD) — required for Nigeria entry.`
maya patel: Perfect, will preapprove and book at the approved clinic. Thanks :thumbsup:
people-ops: Thanks @maya patel — ping us if the embassy asks for anything else.
